title: Keep extra cookies set by a route in JWTRefreshMiddleware
body:
Follow-up to #70783.

The middleware already lets a route's own `_token` cookie win over the one it would append, but cookies returned by the new `get_extra_cookies` hook were always appended after the route's. When the session is invalidated (e.g. a login callback reached with an expired `_token`), a subclass clearing its extra cookies would wipe the ones the route had just issued: the browser applies the later `Max-Age=0` header. Nothing in-tree uses `get_extra_cookies` yet, so this closes the gap before an auth manager relies on it. The stale root-path `_token` is still cleared, since the route only sets the token on the cookie path.

Also fixes `test_generate_new_user_token`: the single-argument parametrize received one-element tuples, so the case without a new user never ran.

@@ -102,12 +102,16 @@ async def send_with_cookies(message: Message) -> None:
             if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                 response_started = True
                 headers = MutableHeaders(scope=message)
-                cookie_values = cleanup_cookies
-                # The token set by the route itself wins: appending ours after it would override it.
-                if token_cookie and not any(
-                    value.startswith(f"{COOKIE_NAME_JWT_TOKEN}=") for value in headers.getlist("set-cookie")
-                ):
-                    cookie_values = [token_cookie, *cleanup_cookies]
+                route_cookie_names = {value.split("=", 1)[0] for value in headers.getlist("set-cookie")}
+                cookie_values = []
+                # Cookies set by the route itself win: appending ours after them would override them.
+                if token_cookie and COOKIE_NAME_JWT_TOKEN not in route_cookie_names:
+                    cookie_values.append(token_cookie)
+                for value in cleanup_cookies:
+                    name = value.split("=", 1)[0]
+                    # The root-path token cleanup targets "/", not the cookie path the route sets the token on.
+                    if name == COOKIE_NAME_JWT_TOKEN or name not in route_cookie_names:
+                        cookie_values.append(value)
                 for value in cookie_values:
                     headers.append("set-cookie", value)
             await send(message)
